acceptTerms: I have read and accept these terms.
adminPaused: An administrator has paused payments for this app.
allowFlowPayments: Allow this app to collect payments from flows
balanceScope: This balance belongs to your Stripe account and can include activity outside FlowLike.
checkoutDescription: Review the purchase terms, then continue to Stripe. Access is added after the server confirms payment.
checkoutUnavailable: Purchasing is unavailable in this app distribution.
confirmNodePayment: I agree to pay the amount above to this app's owner for the item shown.
disconnectExplanation: Disconnecting stops new payments. Existing orders and refunds remain available. Your Stripe account stays open.
earningsDescription: Review payments credited to your account and manage refunds for your marketplace sales.
invalidEuroAmount: Enter a euro amount with at most two decimal places.
legacyHistoryDescription: These purchases used the earlier platform checkout. Their original records and available receipts remain accessible.
onboardingPaused: New payment account setup is currently unavailable. Existing account details remain accessible.
onboardingReady: Your Stripe setup link is ready. Open it to continue, then return here and refresh your status.
ownerOnly: Only the app owner can change payment settings.
ownerReceives: Payments go to the app owner's connected Stripe account. Transferring ownership pauses new payments until the new owner completes setup.
packageCheckoutDescription: Review the purchase terms, then continue to Stripe. You can install the package once the server confirms payment.
packagePriceDescription: What a buyer pays once to install this package. At zero the package is free.
packagePriceRequiresOpenListing: Packages that need access approval cannot be sold. Make the listing public to set a price.
packageSellerReady: Your payment account can receive sales of this package.
packageSellerSetupNeeded: Complete your payment account setup before you set a price for this package.
packageSellerTermsBeforePrice: Accept the current seller terms before you sell this package.
paymentRequestDescription: The running flow is waiting for your decision. Review the recipient and amount before continuing.
payoutsDescription: Connect a Stripe account to receive payments for your apps. Stripe collects your business and payout details.
platformPackageReceives: You are a Flow-Like administrator. Sales of this package go to Flow-Like's Stripe account.
purchasesDescription: Check payment status, open receipts, and manage eligible withdrawals. Payment confirmation may take a moment after checkout.
readyToCollect: The owner's account can accept payments.
receiptUnavailable: A Stripe receipt is not available for this purchase.
refundSubmitted: Refund requested. Its status will update after Stripe processes it.
reportEffect: Reporting also cancels this payment request.
requestExpired: This payment request has expired. Any payment already processing is being reconciled.
requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Try again.
returnDescription: You can return to the app now. Your payment or account status is confirmed by the server and may still be processing.
returnSignIn: Sign in to view your purchases or continue payment account setup.
sellerRefundConfirmation: Confirm a refund of {{amount}}? This cannot be undone.
sellerTermsBeforePrice: Accept the current seller terms before you set a price for this app.
sellerTermsDescription: Accept the current seller terms before offering this app for sale. Listing price and visibility remain in the app settings.
setupNeeded: The owner must complete payment setup before this app can collect payments.
simulationDescription: This local Board Test uses a simulated result. No payment was collected.
withdrawConfirmation: Access from this purchase will end when the withdrawal is recorded. You do not need to give a reason.
platformPaymentsDescription: Your apps collect marketplace and flow payments in Flow-Like's Stripe account. Proceeds belong to Flow-Like. Connected account setup is unavailable for platform administrators.
platformAppReceives: This app's owner is a Flow-Like administrator. Marketplace and flow payments go to Flow-Like's Stripe account, with no transfer to a personal account.
platformReadyToCollect: Flow-Like can collect payments for this app.
platformPaymentsUnavailable: Payments are currently unavailable for this app.
platformEarningsDescription: Review payments collected by Flow-Like and manage marketplace refunds. Each payment retains its original recipient; any earlier connected account payments are labeled separately.
platformBalanceScope: This is Flow-Like's entire Stripe balance, including other apps and billing activity. It is not a personal payout balance.
confirmPlatformNodePayment: I agree to pay the amount above to Flow-Like for the item shown.
withdrawDeclaration: I withdraw from the purchase identified above.
withdrawConfirmationEmailHelp: We will send your declaration and its receipt date and time to this address.
findPurchaseHelp: Enter the order reference from your confirmation email to open any purchase, including older orders.
